rules.name: firewall-cert
rules.title: FirewallCertChanged
rules._comment: check-firewall-cert runs on the mothership and logs there.
rules.summary: The firewall's API certificate changed (expected after a firewall rebuild or a certificate renewal — otherwise something answers as the firewall), or expires within 30 days. The line names the old and new fingerprints.

rules.name: opnsense-login-failed
rules.title: FirewallLoginFailed
rules.headline: Firewall sign-in failures
rules._comment: OPNsense's audit log over syslog; the message text is to be confirmed on a live firewall.
rules.summary: More than three failed sign-ins to the firewall's web UI from one address in ten minutes.

rules.name: suricata-alert
rules.title: IdsAlert
rules.headline: IDS alert
rules._comment: Suricata's eve alerts over syslog (ADR-050 D5): every alert is recorded with its count; the severe ones are SuricataHigh.
rules.summary: Suricata on the firewall's WAN raised an alert. Recorded, not raised: on a WAN most alerts are the internet's background.

rules.name: suricata-high
rules.title: IdsAlertHigh
rules.headline: IDS alert, high severity
rules._comment: Severity 1 in ET Open and abuse.ch: exploits, malware command-and-control, known-bad hosts.
rules.summary: Suricata raised a high-severity alert on the WAN: an exploit attempt, or traffic to or from a known-bad host. The alert names the signature and the addresses.
